decisions.why: Toilet Surrounds and Toilet Frames are bathing and toileting aids, a direct category match.
Foot stools and perching stools are daily living aids for use around the home.
Apollo Wheelchair is a wheelchair (rehab:chair) while Gemini/Taurus rollators are walking aids (rehab:walk) - genuine split across two types.
Universal Wheelchair Headrest, Transport Chair with Bag and Transit Chair are wheelchair/transit-chair products and accessories.
Freedom II Profiling Bed and Bed Lever are beds (handling:bed); Scorpio Back Support and Postural Wedge are positioning aids (handling:mattress).
